plants.where: A nursery, in bloom (Jensen sent them 2026-11-24; which nursery and the date are not given)
plants.notes: Seven plain photos came through chat at 1125x1500, so there is no larger original in the repo. `pink-haze` and `pink-haze-wide` are two frames of the same clump. Slide 1 and 4 use `clumps-drift`, slide 2 uses `pink-haze`, slide 3 uses `backlit-plume`, slide 5 uses `plumes-oak`. A real planting of the white form, White Cloud muhly, is in `images/projects/blazyk/IMG_3199` (Overlook at Lewis Mountain).

describe.gulf-muhly-pink-haze: Gulf muhly in bloom: a pink haze of flower heads over green wiry blades, with one stem arching across the top
describe.gulf-muhly-pink-haze-wide: Second frame of the same clump as pink-haze, framed a little wider
describe.gulf-muhly-clump-blades: One clump in a black nursery pot: green blades fanning out from the base with a pale pink plume rising through the middle
describe.gulf-muhly-backlit-plume: Close view of one flower head with the sun behind it, the fine branches glowing pink and white
describe.gulf-muhly-plumes-oak: Pink and tan plumes with green stems standing through them, an oak and blue sky behind
describe.gulf-muhly-tall-plume: A tall column of pink plumes in a row of gulf muhly, nursery ground and a greenhouse behind
describe.gulf-muhly-clumps-drift: Several clumps side by side: separate green mounds below, the pink flower heads running together above
